'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Ryan Sellman LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Sellman]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Username:''' Sne89837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
